name: ahn
description: When a web fetch or browser step fails, look up the hostname on Agent Help Network: the host's declared agent policy (robots.txt, llms.txt), the official developer path, provider status, and published observations, with one recommended action. The hook is read-only and sends the hostname only. The bundled MCP server also offers report_observation, a write tool: use it only with the user's explicit approval, never automatically.
